mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour Bill Williams Market Facilitation Index green state—both range-per-volume and volume increasing—indicates new participation accelerating in the direction of bar development; follow that completed bar direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed bar close minus open when both BW MFI and base volume exceed their immediately prior completed values
mechanism.why_distinct: BW MFI is current high-low expansion per unit of base volume and its green state requires facilitation and participation to rise together. It is not Money Flow Index, raw range or volume alone, volume-weighted momentum, taker flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the participation-backed facilitation state must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: four-hour joint range-per-volume and volume acceleration states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), with high=max, low=min, open=first, close=last, base volume=sum
features.bw_mfi: (completed bar high-completed bar low)/completed base volume, strict positive range and volume
features.green_state: current finite BW MFI strictly exceeds immediately prior finite BW MFI and current base volume strictly exceeds immediately prior positive base volume
features.bar_direction: strict sign of completed close-open; zero body is ineligible
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official Bill Williams green state under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no volume field, state, bar direction, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Bill Williams Market Facilitation Index as documented by MetaQuotes
external_basis.fixed_definition: BW MFI=(HIGH-LOW)/VOLUME; green state when BW MFI increases and volume increases; new players align positions in the direction of bar development
external_basis.selection_use: official formula, green-state classification, and stated bar-direction interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
